title: Instance Metadata
description: Metadata file for describing a Roblox instance (className, properties, keepUnknowns).

className.description: The ClassName of the instance this metadata describes.

robloxName.description: The real Roblox Instance.Name when the filesystem entry uses a disambiguated name.

amarilloId.description: Internal stable identity used to match duplicate Roblox siblings.

duplicateOrdinal.description: Ordinal for a duplicate sibling with the same Roblox name.

properties.description: Properties to apply to this instance.

keepUnknowns.description: If true, instances not described in the project tree are kept (not deleted).
